caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is named Median full time gross weekly pay of the highest paid occupations in the United Kingdom (UK) as of April 2020 (in British pounds). The y-axis measures Median full time gross weekly pay in GBP as linear scale from 0 to 1,500 while the x-axis shows business with categorical scale from Advertising and public relations directors to Train and tram drivers.
caption_L2L3: Chief executives and senior officials have the highest median pay, of over £1500 per week. Train and tram drivers have the lowest median pay of a little over £1000 per week.
